seventh.title: Texas takes the lead
seventh.description: Russell Martin’s throw back to the pitcher deflects off Shin-Soo Choo’s hand. The umpires allow Rougned Odor’s run from third.

seventh.title: Donaldson brings Toronto level
seventh.description: Three consecutive Texas errors help load the bases. Kevin Pillar scores from third when Donaldson’s fly drops in and Texas gets a force at second.

seventh.title: Bautista’s three-run homer
seventh.description: With two outs and two men on, José Bautista takes Sam Dyson deep. Toronto goes ahead for good, 6–3.
